svg.title: 03 · Collection, evidence and history
svg.desc: Collection, evidence and history. A source has stable identity; every observation and interpretation pins the version it used

g.text: A source has stable identity; every observation and interpretation pins the version it used
version · createdAt · updatedAt | Retained versions never change; a write appends the next version.
EntityRef = {kind, id, version}. A dashed class is the same entity shown on another sheet.
All non-Workspace entities carry workspaceId. Cardinalities describe logical associations; fields shown are selected attributes.

g.title: One finite collection with immutable query definitions and changing lifecycle represented by ordinary entity versions. New query definitions require a new collection identity.
A single request attempt exists even if it returned zero objects or failed. It is immutable once settled.
Immutable receipt/read observation of one revision. Repeated polls do not create new logical objects. Event/stream/local receipts may have no ReadAttempt; no native read is fabricated.

Versioned retained source representation. Stable sourceId is scoped by native identity, representation, profile and source operation, independently of payload digest or provider version. Changed accepted content appends a version; an unchanged poll observes the current version again.
Versioned named derived view with exact input references, coverage and rule identity. New inputs or rule versions append an immutable version under the same projectionId.

A deliberate retained capture with a closed set of exact entity references and captured contents. Snapshot is a business capture, not a substitute for ordinary entity versioning. A corrected capture appends a Snapshot version; older captures stay unchanged.
Durable intent and receipt; conditional local admission is not an AWS transaction. Unknown remote outcomes are reconciled without inventing success.
Observation 0..* → Projection 0..*: used as immutable input
Source 0..* → Projection 0..*: used as immutable input

g.text: all use the same version contract.
Exact inputs are EntityRef values. No version
class or per-entity version collection is needed.
